programme.title: Desperate Hours
programme.desc: Life on planet Earth is a fragile enough proposition as it is. The Earth is an interconnected system, everything is dependent on everything else, and we as a species should learn how to avoid making things worse than they need to be. In this rather sobering instalment of Desperate Hours our special focus is on Environmental Disasters. We will explore what has actually been done to protect the environment in contrast to the long discussions on this topic. From polluting the planet in various ways to the effects of global warming we contemplate how our future might be affected. As custodians of the planet, are we not better to be safe, rather than sorry?

programme.title: RV Explorers
programme.desc: RV Explorers, chasing 100 Sunsets. A TV show following a new motorhoming couple as they explore the towns and regions of NZ - experiencing various tourist attractions, events and joining in with other motorhomers to experience their favourite activities.

programme.title: RV Explorers
programme.desc: RV Explorers, chasing 100 Sunsets. A TV show following a new motorhoming couple as they explore the towns and regions of NZ - experiencing various tourist attractions, events and joining in with other motorhomers to experience their favourite activities.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Travel Thru History (or TTH for short) is a new educational/informational (E/I) series designed to spark interest and enthusiasm in viewers to learn about our country's rich and fascinating history by traveling to diverse locales across the US. While it is targeted to a teen audience, the entire family will enjoy watching TTH. Videotaped and edited in the style of other popular, educational programming like Modern Marvels, Travel Thru History is the latest television series co-developed by The Television Syndication Company and Red 5 Creative.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Travel Thru History is an Emmy-nominated, un-hosted lifestyle/travel series designed to spark interest and enthusiasm in viewers about our world's rich and fascinating history by traveling to diverse locales across the globe. Locations include New Orleans, Las Vegas, Oslo, Belize, Dublin and more. In this episode we visit the Kennedy Space Center located on Florida's famous "Space Coast." We'll speak to NASA engineers about the past, present and future of American space travel, as well as take a look at the attractions KSC has to offer.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Snow is a fascinating world of crystals that animals, plants, and humans have had to adapt to, in order to benefit from its best and survive its worst attributes. Some communities live with Tornadoes by building homes with survival features and rather than get out of their paths, they rely on warning systems and classifications. And behind all great weather events is Wind, find out how and why it can change from a gentle breeze into a devastating gale force and where does it go? Nature's force can be mystical and puzzling and the Sunshower has been the subject of myths and legends and superstitions, but it does have a scientific explanation.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: What is La Nina and how is it being monitored? Find out the effects and the reach that this system is influencing. How did Indian Summer get its name and what is the science behind the phenomenon? Winter is the season that has the biggest effect on the planet, animal behaviour and often brings out the worst that nature can bring. Nature's Halo is a magical sight with a scientific explanation. The story of and lessons from Hurricane Katrina give us a great understanding of the ferocity and speed that nature can unleash.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Humpback Whales, perfect water, summer sunshine and one of the finest fishing Chinook Salmon solo fishing days!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears journeys into the remote wilderness region of Arnhem land to the Cooper Creek Billabong. He's there during the dry season and all the wild life is concentrated into a narrow stretch of water. He comes face to face with the dominant saltwater crocodile and watches as the croc manoeuvres a dead pig down river to a secret hiding place. When Ray gets too close warns him off.Ray travels into Stone Country above the Billabong where he finds a gallery of ancient Aboriginal art and joins locals Connie Nayinggul and her grandson Moses on a fishing expedition. They catch a barramundi and cook the fish in a traditional ground oven using paper bark.Finally Ray travels with land manager Greg Towns across the dried up mudflats through giant flocks of Magpie Geese. Ray helps Greg to burn away large meadows of alien and destructive grass that is killing the birds. In a dramatic scene Ray witnesses the spectacle of farming with fire.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world - something that starts with simply getting out of town!

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Just north of India is a land steeped in mystery—Nepal. Bill tours the city of Kathmandu, visits the World Heritage temple complexes, and walks along the city streets, where ancient and modern vie for space. We fly around Mount Everest, arguably the world's most famous mountain, before heading into Chitwan National Park. In Chitwan, Bill searches for tigers from the back of an elephant and observes the myriad of wildlife that call the park home.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Journeys in India is a ground-breaking travel series focusing on the Indian subcontinent. This first season highlights the history, culture, architecture, and wildlife of one of the most mysterious and exciting areas on earth. Perfect for the would-be or armchair traveler, this 13 part series is beautifully filmed with all original footage. Join host Bill Ball as he takes you on the adventures of a lifetime!

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: This is definitely the land of the elephant. Large herds of pachyderms roam this marshy park putting on a show for whoever wants to watch. But that's not the only big boys of this park—buffalo, lion and a host of hoofed game make this a wonder to behold.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: This under-visited, and far western Kenyan park area, is renowned for its giant flamingo gatherings that literally turn lakes pink. We explore these many parks on foot, in a safari vehicle and on horseback searching out the local legends that have marked this region the death zone. Our host faces imminent doom in three unique parks in this fast-paced episode.

programme.title: Yves Saint Laurent - Fire Starter
programme.desc: A documentary of a true pioneer of fashion. Sabbatical Entertainment celebrates one of the most influential designers ever as we explore the designer's unparalleled professional acclaim, as well as his fascinating and tumultuous personal life. Yves Saint Laurent can be credited with both spurring the couture's rise in the 1960s as well as the tuxedo suit for women. He was able to adapt his style to accommodate the changes in fashion during his entire career. Sabbatical Entertainment's original documentary shows viewers how YSL approached fashion with a different narrative by wanting women to look comfortable yet elegant at the same time.

programme.title: For Our Eyes Only
programme.desc: In anticipation of the premiere of the 25 chapter in the iconic James Bond Saga, based on the novels of British writer Ian Fleming, Sabbatical Entertainment presents FOR OUR EYES ONLY an enthralling documentary in which we will relive all of 007 dangerous mission throughout this legendary cinematic franchise, from the first feature film production in 1962, "Dr. No", to the highly anticipated "No Time To Die." In "For Our Eyes Only," get to know all the actors who have embodied the super spy: Sean Connery, George Lazenby, Roger Moore, Timothy Dalton, Pierce Brosnan, and Daniel Craig, their similarities and characteristics that differentiate each one when exhibiting his well-known charm, class and elegance, combined with physical and mental prowess, that makes 007 a real life super hero. In "For Our Eyes Only" we pay homage to the gadgets, watches, planes, submarines, but most of all, the cars 007 has used throughout the films history to survive and complete so many missions. Travel to the locations of each big budget production to honor all the memorable Bond girls who have graced the silver screen alongside the debonair secret agent, and cringe in fear remembering the Machiavellian villains and their evil plots….if it were not for Bond, James Bond. After watching Sabbatical Entertainment's documentary "For Our Eyes Only" , agree it is you will agree, it definitely is "No Time To Die"

programme.title: Berber, A Quest For Water
programme.desc: In the remote valleys of the Atlas range in Morocco, lies a village Tizi Anoucheg, where water is a rare resource. Berbers are the only people to be found in this harsh environment. They convert the red and dried valleys into a lush green using ancestral irrigation methods. With climate change threatening their very existence one man rises to the occasion & tries to solve the severe water problem.

programme.title: The World's Greatest Carnivals: Quebec Winter Carnival
programme.desc: This 3D documentary special takes us to one of the most colourful and elaborate celebrations on earth where both human creativity and glorious cultures come together. The Quebec Winter Carnival is the world's largest winter Carnival. It celebrates everything about winter with all sorts of unique competitions and celebrations - from Canoe races across the St. Lawrence River to horse racing with sleds, dog-sledding, skating, ice sculptures, food, music and fun.

programme.title: Volcanic Planet
programme.desc: Volcanoes are the most extreme, dramatic, and explosive forces of nature on our planet. Volcanoes have produced many of the most valuable minerals - and most of the arable soil on earth. Every day, they are exploding around the world. When the Yellowstone Super Volcano blows (and it is now 48,000 years overdue to do so), it will destroy most of life on North America. Award-winning filmmaker Peter Rowe has climbed and filmed 19 volcanoes, and tells the story of them, the adventures of climbing them, the people who live beside them, and the scientists who risk their lives to study them, in "Volcanic Planet". He also convinces his climbing partner George Kourounis to get married (!?) on the exploding lip of one of them. Filmed in Congo, Iceland, Italy, Vanuatu, Hawaii, Tonga, Turkey, Guatemala, New Zealand, Costa Rica and under the Pacific Ocean, "Volcanic Planet" is a fast-paced high-voltage tour of the world's most active smoking mountains.

programme.title: The Subversives
programme.desc: Theo van Boven becomes Director of Human Rights for the UN in 1977, where it was impossible to even name a country for gross violations. No bureaucrat, he battles the most repressive regimes of the late 20th century, such as Chile and Argentina and opens the UN door for the first time to "subversive" survivors from across the world. Risking everything, he even takes on the US and the Secretary General.

programme.title: Vacaciones Con Fidel
programme.desc: Tristan is a journalist with deep political convictions who worked for years doing journalistic research. Once married and with three children, he accepts a much more remunerative job on commercial television and gradually becomes involved in a life he did not expect.

programme.title: Survivors Of the Invisible
programme.desc: One million different species of insects live on Earth. Diving into their world is kind of like adventuring to a faraway and unknown galaxy. With one difference: these living creatures do not live light-years away from us but right under our feet! With unique technologies shots developed by an Austrian entomologist, the film Survivors of the Invisible will make you discover the world of insects as you have never seen it before.

programme.title: Fundamentalism: Is There A Way Back
programme.desc: A growing counter-terrorist movement is gaining worldwide momentum.After the attacks in New York, London, Madrid and Bali as well as the assassinations in Toulouse carried out by Mohamed Merah, the world wonders about how these Islamists came to the point they were able to commit such atrocities: to kill in cold blood and be willing to die a Martyr's death. How and why did these young men become radicals? Is it reversible?In a number of countries, deradicalization programs have sprung up. Have they been successful? In this documentary, the first ever of its kind, reporters will meet with some Islamists – former terrorists – who have left the path of terror and now dedicate their lives to persuading other terrorists to do the same.

programme.title: Boteti: The Returning River
programme.desc: For 20 years the Boteti River in northern Botswana has not flowed. What was once an expansive and prolific body of water gradually dried up, leaving zebras, hippos, elephants and crocodiles dependant on the few pools formed from the occasional rains.But now, for the first time in 30 years, rain has fallen in sufficient quantities hundreds of miles to the north in the Angolan highlands, sending a stream of water through the river bed. After years of extreme drought, the river has finally returned in all its glory, transforming the landscape. Filmed in stunning HD, "Boteti - The Returning River" documents this extraordinary transformation and the dramatic changes it brings to the resident animals.During the years of drought, we see how desperate battles for survival play out along the dormant river, watched over by the elephants of the area. One of the few species that adapts well to the situation by carefully conserving what little water is available, the elephant is an expert at digging channels in the mud so water collects in sufficient quantities to drink.Vultures lurk ominously on the dusty banks adjacent to the pools, waiting patiently for dehydration to claim another victim. Crocodiles use caves to escape the heat of the sun and only emerge reluctantly to hunt when huge flocks of quelea birds arrive at the water. The crocs, along with numerous other species, are bound to this area because there is simply nowhere else to go. Beyond the dry river bed, semi-desert extends for hundreds of miles in all directions.With the arrival of the life-giving waters, there is a burst of activity. Fish and dragonflies soon emerge with their attendant predators and frogs appear in their thousands, attracting huge numbers of birds. The deluge also brings instant relief to the hippos by flushing out their fetid pools, while elephants celebrate by swimming and hosing each other down. Jackals and packs of wild dogs appear from nowhere to harass the drinking herds.But the most significant change occurs when the water reaches the parched wasteland of the Makgadigadi Salt Pans. Here, the coming of the flood sees flocks of pelican, flamingo and red-billed teal arrive to set up new breeding colonies.Filmed over a period of two years, this film provides a lasting and unique record of the transformation of an entire environment and contains many examples of previously unrecorded behaviour.

programme.title: Džona F. Kenedija slepkavība
programme.desc: Nekas neliecina par iespējamām briesmām, kad Džons F. Kenedijs 1963. gada 22. novembrī ierodas Dalasā, kur viņu silti sagaida Teksasas iedzīvotāji. Pulksten 12.29, vien 60 sekundes pirms pirmā šāviena, valsts pirmais pāris smaida un māj apmeklētājiem. Taču tad atskan šāviens, kas netrāpa mērķī, toties izraisa haosu. Nav saprotams, no kurienes šauts. Otrais un trešais šāviens prezidentam izrādās liktenīgi. Amerikas Savienoto Valstu prezidents ir nogalināts tūkstošiem aculiecinieku priekšā.

programme.title: Džona F. Kenedija slepkavība
programme.desc: Prezidentam Kenedijam ierodoties Dalasā, nekas neliecina par briesmām. Prezidents un viņa sieva Džekija tiek uzņemti ar sajūsmu, un Dalasas ielas ir pārpildītas. Taču 12.30 izceļas panika, jo uz prezidentu tiek raidīts šāviens un nav saprotams, no kurienes tas nācis. Vēl divi šāvieni, un prezidents Kenedijs ir miris. Šis notikums ir radījis neskaitāmas sazvērestību teorijas par ložu trajektorijām un šāvēju skaitu. Pēc oficiālās versijas šāvējs bija viens – Lī Hārvijs Osvalds.

programme.title: Pirmās 48 stundas
programme.desc: Pirmās 48 stundas pēc nozieguma izdarīšanas izmeklētāju darbā ir visbūtiskākās, jo tieši šis laikposms nereti izšķir to, vai noziegums tiks atšķetināts. Vēlāk izmeklētāju izredzes notvert vainīgo sarūk uz pusi. Raidījums ļauj ielūkoties ASV slepkavību izmeklētāju ikdienā, kuri neatlaidīgi strādā, lai jau pirmajās nozieguma izdarīšanas stundās atklātu pēc iespējas vairāk detaļu par ļaunprātības apstākļiem. Skatītājus sagaida reāls izmeklēšanas process, liecinieku intervijas, kriminālistiskās ekspertīzes aizkulises un iespēja ielūkoties vietās, kur nupat pastrādāts noziegums.

programme.title: Ofiss
programme.desc: Šī ir seriāla pirmā sezona, kurā vairs nefilmējas lieliskais aktieris Stīvs Karels Maikla Skota lomā, tomēr uztraukumam nav pamata, jo īpašais "Ofisa" humors nekur nav pazudis! programme.title: Mika
programme.desc: Makenzija, saukta par Miku, dzīvi tver viegli un tā arī nav uz savām kājām nostājusies. Kad viņa ierodas pie savas bagātās māsas Pamelas lūgt naudu, notiek negaidītais – māsu un viņas vīru par krāpšanu un izvairīšanos no nodokļiem apcietina FIB, un Pamela lūdz Mikai vienu dienu pieskatīt viņas trīs bērnus. Vienu dienu Mika ar bērniem kaut kā tiek galā, bet tad saņem zvanu no māsas – viņa ar vīru pamet valsti. Nu Mikai, kura jāaudzina trīs izlutināti bērni, un viņas vienīgie palīgi ir draugs Džimijs un mājkalpotāja Alba.

programme.title: Mani sauc Erls
programme.desc: Erls un Rendijs sāk strādāt elektroiekārtu veikala kravu pārvadāšanas nodaļā. Bet Erls grib būt pārdevējs, kas rada problēmas ar viņa kolēģiem savā nodaļā un pārējiem pārdevējiem.

programme.title: Divarpus vīri
programme.desc: Divi brāļi nevarētu būt dažādāki. Čārlijam ir viss, ko dzīvē var vēlēties – nauda, skaista māja okeāna piekrastē, pavisam nedaudz darāmā un neskaitāmas draudzenes –, turpretī Alans ir īsts neveiksminieks – no viņa ir izšķīrusies sieva, kura ir paturējusi sev abu kopīgi iegādāto māju, un Alans nespēj savilkt kopā galus, lai samaksātu rēķinus. Tā kā Alanam nav pa kabatai atļauties savu mājokli, viņš lūdz Čārlijam atļauju padzīvot pie viņa kādu laiciņu, kamēr apradīs ar jauno situāciju un atradīs pats savu mājvietu. Viņi pat nenojauta, uz cik ilgu laiku tas ievilksies un cik daudz jautrības tas sagādās skatītājiem.

programme.title: Pidurdunud areng
programme.desc: Atgriežoties mājās no Irākas, Džordžs vecākais beidzot tiek attaisnots, un Maikls ir atvieglots, jo beidzot vada veiksmīgu uzņēmumu. Atklājas patiesais vaininieks visam trakumam, un tiklīdz ģimene sāk svinēt uzvaru, parādās pavisam jaunas problēmas.

programme.title: Pidurdunud areng
programme.desc: Maikls atvadās no ģimenes biznesa un dibina savu uzņēmumu. Ģimenes dzīve sagriežas kājām gaisā, kad nomirst viņu pastnieks Pīts.

programme.title: Precējies... Ir bērni
programme.desc: Ala Dodge noslēpumaini pazūd vietējā automazgātavā, atrodoties ceļā uz Vankeras apgabalu. Mārsijas bijušais vīrs Stīvs Rodss mistiskā kārtā parādās šajā automazgātavā, lai parādītu viņai savu jauno dzīvi. Viņa savukārt mēģina panākt, lai slinkais Džefersons tur strādātu.

programme.title: Precējies... Ir bērni
programme.desc: Džordžs Plimptons rīko 200. sērijas svinības. Sērijā ietverti klipi no dažādām epizodēm - sākot no 1987. gada atklāšanas sezonas līdz 9. sezonas vidum.

programme.title: Mani sauc Erls
programme.desc: Erls ir liecinieks Džojas tiesas prāvā, bet viņš ātri vien saprot, ka Džoja tiks attaisnota tikai tad, ja viņš atzīsies noziegumā viņas vietā.

programme.title: Mani sauc Erls
programme.desc: Erls sāk izciest cietumsodu. Atrodoties apcietinājumā, viņš sastopas ar Doniju, kurš māca Erlam labāko veidu, kā palikt nepamanītam. Tikmēr Džoja un Darnels, Erlam esot prombūtnē, ir spiesti rūpēties par Rendiju.

programme.title: Mani sauc Erls
programme.desc: Erls sāk izciest cietumsodu. Atrodoties apcietinājumā, viņš sastopas ar Doniju, kurš māca Erlam labāko veidu, kā palikt nepamanītam. Tikmēr Džoja un Darnels, Erlam esot prombūtnē, ir spiesti rūpēties par Rendiju.

programme.title: Divarpus vīri
programme.desc: Divi brāļi nevarētu būt dažādāki. Čārlijam ir viss, ko dzīvē var vēlēties – nauda, skaista māja okeāna piekrastē, pavisam nedaudz darāmā un neskaitāmas draudzenes –, turpretī Alans ir īsts neveiksminieks – no viņa ir izšķīrusies sieva, kura ir paturējusi sev abu kopīgi iegādāto māju, un Alans nespēj savilkt kopā galus, lai samaksātu rēķinus. Tā kā Alanam nav pa kabatai atļauties savu mājokli, viņš lūdz Čārlijam atļauju padzīvot pie viņa kādu laiciņu, kamēr apradīs ar jauno situāciju un atradīs pats savu mājvietu. Viņi pat nenojauta, uz cik ilgu laiku tas ievilksies un cik daudz jautrības tas sagādās skatītājiem.

Čārlijam ir viss, ko dzīvē var vēlēties – nauda, skaista māja okeāna piekrastē, pavisam nedaudz darāmā un neskaitāmas draudzenes –, turpretī Alans ir īsts neveiksminieks – no viņa ir izšķīrusies sieva, kura ir paturējusi sev abu kopīgi iegādāto māju, un Alans nespēj savilkt kopā galus, lai samaksātu rēķinus. Tā kā Alanam nav pa kabatai atļauties savu mājokli, viņš lūdz Čārlijam atļauju padzīvot pie viņa kādu laiciņu, kamēr apradīs ar jauno situāciju un atradīs pats savu mājvietu. Viņi pat nenojauta, uz cik ilgu laiku tas ievilksies un cik daudz jautrības tas sagādās skatītājiem.

programme.title: Precējies... Ir bērni
programme.desc: Viņu 25. kāzu gadadienā Pegija kopā ar Mārsiju dodas uz greznu spa, kur dāvanu veikala darbinieks pārdodot lētas skaistumkopšanas preces, un izkrāpj Pegijai visu viņas naudu.

programme.title: Precējies... Ir bērni
programme.desc: Pega laimē kruīzu, bet nolemj paņemt līdzi Alu un Darsiju, atstājot bērnus mājās ar Volfmenu Džeku, taču, kā vienmēr, seko nelaime.

programme.title: Mika
programme.desc: Makenzija, saukta par Miku, dzīvi tver viegli un tā arī nav uz savām kājām nostājusies. Kad viņa ierodas pie savas bagātās māsas Pamelas lūgt naudu, notiek negaidītais – māsu un viņas vīru par krāpšanu un izvairīšanos no nodokļiem apcietina FIB, un Pamela lūdz Mikai vienu dienu pieskatīt viņas trīs bērnus. Vienu dienu Mika ar bērniem kaut kā tiek galā, bet tad saņem zvanu no māsas – viņa ar vīru pamet valsti. Nu Mikai, kura jāaudzina trīs izlutināti bērni, un viņas vienīgie palīgi ir draugs Džimijs un mājkalpotāja Alba.

programme.title: Women's Boulder | Final World Series | Salt Lake City
Поговори с ней
programme.desc: Катя и Саша дружили с детства. Но их дружбу разрушила любовь к одному мужчине – Артему, который выбрал Катю. День свадьбы должен был стать самым счастливым в жизни влюбленных, но стал последним их днем. Жестокая игра дяди Артема – Валерия, жаждущего денег и власти, едва не стоила жизни Кате и сделала несчастной Сашу. И только простив друг друга, подруги смогли все преодолеть и найти настоящую любовь. На этот раз – каждая свою...

programme.title: Дневники Темного
programme.desc: Телеканал ТЕТ подготовил для вас нечто очень неожиданное. Проект придется по вкусу всем любителям загадочных мистических историй. События происходят в фантастическом городе Темный. В нем живут вампиры, оборотни и другие существа. Все здесь живет и дышит, даже стены домов. Попасть в этот загадочный город совсем не сложно, а вот покинуть - невероятно сложно. Однажды в город приезжает журналист. Его задача - освещать события, происходящие в Темном. Однако все осложняется тем, что отличить где правда, а где только галлюцинации, в городе бывает невероятно трудно. В каждом выпуске он расследует новые мистические дела. Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

programme.title: Семейные мелодрамы
programme.desc: Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.title: Школа
programme.desc: Успешная бизнес-леди Катя узнает, что её дочь пыталась покончить жизнь самоубийством. Как оказалось, не впервые. Чтобы быть ближе к дочери и понять, чем на самом деле занимаются дети в школе, она начинает работать учительницей экономики. Молодая мама понятия не имела, какие секреты скрываются за стенами обычной школы. Тогда же в учебное заведение приходит новый преподаватель английского - бывший адвокат и сын директора Алекс. У него есть невеста, которая живет в США, но вдруг между ним и Екатериной промелькнула искра. Впрочем, скелеты прошлого всё ещё дают о себе знать и не отпускают героев...

programme.title: Женский доктор
programme.desc: Действие разворачивается в новой современной клинике, которую основал профессор Юрий Климов. Бывшему тестю доктора Романа Широкова остался лишь год до выхода на пенсию, и за это время он должен найти достойного преемника. Но это не главная причина, по которой профессор вновь приглашает Романа работать вместе. Роман Широков – единственный, кто может довести до конца инновационную научную разработку, от которой зависит судьба дочери профессора - Нины. Однако инвесторы и сотрудники клиники не рады появлению нового профессионала.

programme.title: Крепостная
programme.desc: Юная сирота Катерина Вербицкая — очень красивая, умная и образованная девушка. Благодаря ее крестной матери Катю воспитали как барышню благородных кровей. Она знает иностранные языки, играет на фортепиано, рисует и прекрасно понимает, что все это никак не облегчит судьбу рожденной в неволе. Катерина принадлежит самым богатым помещикам в Нежине — Червинским. Девушка существует между двумя мирами — миром крепостных и дворян. И ни в одном из них для нее нет места. Жизнь приготовила Катерине немало сюрпризов. В борьбе за свое счастье ей придется пережить смерти близких, спастись от преследований маньяка, выбраться из мира киевских борделей. И главное — победить свою хозяйку, жестокую помещицу, которая хочет убить ее. Крепостная пройдет сквозь ад и встретится с ужасными испытаниями судьбы. Что же ее ждет в конце жесткой борьбы за право быть свободной и любимой?

programme.title: Страх в твоем доме
programme.desc: Боль и страдания, которые причиняют самые близкие люди, невыносимы. Дом из крепости становится тюрьмой. И в поисках выхода людям приходится идти на самые невероятные поступки. Ни один сценарист не сможет придумать такие сюжетные ходы, которые порой закручивает сама жизнь. В социальной докудраме "Страх в твоем доме" - только реальные истории, случившиеся с реальными людьми. Мы реконструируем события, основываясь на откровенных рассказах их участников, а наши эксперты - юристы и психологи - комментируют их и помогают найти выход из сложных, порой тупиковых ситуаций.

programme.title: Дневники Темного
programme.desc: Телеканал ТЕТ подготовил для вас нечто очень неожиданное. Проект придется по вкусу всем любителям загадочных мистических историй. События происходят в фантастическом городе Темный. В нем живут вампиры, оборотни и другие существа. Все здесь живет и дышит, даже стены домов. Попасть в этот загадочный город совсем не сложно, а вот покинуть - невероятно сложно. Однажды в город приезжает журналист. Его задача - освещать события, происходящие в Темном. Однако все осложняется тем, что отличить где правда, а где только галлюцинации, в городе бывает невероятно трудно. В каждом выпуске он расследует новые мистические дела. Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

programme.title: Школа
programme.desc: Успешная бизнес-леди Катя узнает, что её дочь пыталась покончить жизнь самоубийством. Как оказалось, не впервые. Чтобы быть ближе к дочери и понять, чем на самом деле занимаются дети в школе, она начинает работать учительницей экономики. Молодая мама понятия не имела, какие секреты скрываются за стенами обычной школы. Тогда же в учебное заведение приходит новый преподаватель английского - бывший адвокат и сын директора Алекс. У него есть невеста, которая живет в США, но вдруг между ним и Екатериной промелькнула искра. Впрочем, скелеты прошлого всё ещё дают о себе знать и не отпускают героев...

programme.title: Женский доктор
programme.desc: Действие разворачивается в новой современной клинике, которую основал профессор Юрий Климов. Бывшему тестю доктора Романа Широкова остался лишь год до выхода на пенсию, и за это время он должен найти достойного преемника. Но это не главная причина, по которой профессор вновь приглашает Романа работать вместе. Роман Широков – единственный, кто может довести до конца инновационную научную разработку, от которой зависит судьба дочери профессора - Нины. Однако инвесторы и сотрудники клиники не рады появлению нового профессионала.

programme.title: Крепостная
programme.desc: Юная сирота Катерина Вербицкая — очень красивая, умная и образованная девушка. Благодаря ее крестной матери Катю воспитали как барышню благородных кровей. Она знает иностранные языки, играет на фортепиано, рисует и прекрасно понимает, что все это никак не облегчит судьбу рожденной в неволе. Катерина принадлежит самым богатым помещикам в Нежине — Червинским. Девушка существует между двумя мирами — миром крепостных и дворян. И ни в одном из них для нее нет места. Жизнь приготовила Катерине немало сюрпризов. В борьбе за свое счастье ей придется пережить смерти близких, спастись от преследований маньяка, выбраться из мира киевских борделей. И главное — победить свою хозяйку, жестокую помещицу, которая хочет убить ее. Крепостная пройдет сквозь ад и встретится с ужасными испытаниями судьбы. Что же ее ждет в конце жесткой борьбы за право быть свободной и любимой?

programme.title: Страх в твоем доме
programme.desc: Боль и страдания, которые причиняют самые близкие люди, невыносимы. Дом из крепости становится тюрьмой. И в поисках выхода людям приходится идти на самые невероятные поступки. Ни один сценарист не сможет придумать такие сюжетные ходы, которые порой закручивает сама жизнь. В социальной докудраме "Страх в твоем доме" - только реальные истории, случившиеся с реальными людьми. Мы реконструируем события, основываясь на откровенных рассказах их участников, а наши эксперты - юристы и психологи - комментируют их и помогают найти выход из сложных, порой тупиковых ситуаций.

programme.title: Страх в твоем доме
programme.desc: Боль и страдания, которые причиняют самые близкие люди, невыносимы. Дом из крепости становится тюрьмой. И в поисках выхода людям приходится идти на самые невероятные поступки. Ни один сценарист не сможет придумать такие сюжетные ходы, которые порой закручивает сама жизнь. В социальной докудраме "Страх в твоем доме" - только реальные истории, случившиеся с реальными людьми. Мы реконструируем события, основываясь на откровенных рассказах их участников, а наши эксперты - юристы и психологи - комментируют их и помогают найти выход из сложных, порой тупиковых ситуаций.

programme.title: Дневники Темного
programme.desc: Телеканал ТЕТ подготовил для вас нечто очень неожиданное. Проект придется по вкусу всем любителям загадочных мистических историй. События происходят в фантастическом городе Темный. В нем живут вампиры, оборотни и другие существа. Все здесь живет и дышит, даже стены домов. Попасть в этот загадочный город совсем не сложно, а вот покинуть - невероятно сложно. Однажды в город приезжает журналист. Его задача - освещать события, происходящие в Темном. Однако все осложняется тем, что отличить где правда, а где только галлюцинации, в городе бывает невероятно трудно. В каждом выпуске он расследует новые мистические дела. Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

programme.title: Семейные мелодрамы
programme.desc: Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.title: The Promise
programme.desc: Adventure movie. Adventure movie, produced in 2005. Two five year old cousins, Anna and ailing Marios, live far away from the see and they never saw it. Anna persuates her father to leave his job and take them to the sea so that Marios will get better.

programme.title: Dragon Blade
programme.desc: In northwest China, 48 BC (50 BC on screen in the English version), a security company under Han China's current government called The Silk Road Protection Squad is committed to stopping battles and promoting the idea of peace. Huo An (Jackie Chan), the captain, successfully averts a battle between the Indian people and Han dynasty. The group returns to their unnamed home city, where Huo An's gentle Uyghurs wife Xiuqing (Mika Wang) serves as a schoolteacher for orphans. However, the government uncovers evidence that someone in the group is corrupt, causing the entire group to be sentenced to construction work at Wild Geese Gate, a ruined fortress. Once they arrive, the group pays respects at the shrine of a fallen Chinese general. They originally were child-slaves of Han descent, but the general had later rescued them.

programme.title: The Ultimate Weapon
programme.desc: When mercenary "Hardball" Cutter discovers that the team he is working with is actually a group of IRA gunrunners, he decides to put a stop to their plans. Furious with Cutter, the gunrunners target him, his partner, and his family.

programme.title: Far Cry
programme.desc: An ex-special forces soldier turned boatman is hired by a journalist to investigate a top-secret military base on a nearby island.

programme.title: Hidden Agenda
programme.desc: Jason Price, a former NSA agent, operates the Daedalus network, which gives clients new identities and makes them disappear. As he lavishes a key witness against a lot of money and is hounded by a hitman (called the Cleaner), he not only sucks the FBI's anger, but also the crime syndicate Icarus, who also turns the cleaner on his best friend, the FBI agent Sonny begin. When Price also lets him submerge and shortly thereafter finds out Sonny's corpse, he realizes that the network has been infiltrated. Price follows the bloody trail of the Cleaner, which leads him not only to the true identity of the Cleaner, but also to its backers.

programme.title: Unknown Energies, Unidentified Emotions
programme.desc: A hybrid of animated, experimental, feature and genre film in found footage technique, with a radio phonic sound and of unexpected, almost 40-minute duration. Journalist Isidor Dukas visits the Institute for Research on Psychic Phenomena and Mental Film when a confrontation with one of the test subjects transforms a routine check into a never-ending maze. Barić's work calls into question issues surrounding artistic practices in the digital age including ideas about authenticity, simulation/replication and appropriation.

programme.title: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: Two cop partners, who are also best friends attend a domestic disturbance, only for one to accidentaly critically wound the other. The rest of the police force are suspicious that there may have been no accident.

programme.title: The Old Man and the Gun
programme.desc: David Lowery's crime biopic stars Robert Redford as Forrest Tucker, a real-life bank robber who found himself wanted by police across the United States for a string of prison escapes and robberies. We first meet Tucker in the early 80s. He's 74 and has been evading police for two years since his last audacious prison break. But he's not taking things easy and laying low. That's not his bag. This suave old geezer has a somehow enamouring way of walking into a bank, charmingly informing the teller that he has a gun that he doesn't want to use, and walking out with a big old sack of cash. In fact, he's just done exactly that when he meets Jewel (Sissy Spacek), an enchanting farmer who he quickly trusts so much that he decides to reveal to her his true identity. Tucker, alongside spending time on Jewel's farm enjoying her more simplistic way of life, embarks on a string of heists. On the case is local detective John Hunt (Casey Affleck), and Tucker soon finds himself torn between the peaceful life he's enjoyed with Jewel and his old criminal ways. Also starring Danny Glover and Tom Waits.

programme.title: Guido Superstar: The Rise of Guido
programme.desc: An Italian immigrant is thrust into the world of drug-lords, supercars and secret agents in this hilarious action comedy. After losing his job at the Disco Valet Company for undue heroism, Guido (Silvio Pollio) must pose as a Sicilian gangster for the FBI in order to infiltrate a powerful Asian gang. Things go sour and take a turn for the worse. Guido must now make amends before he is discovered and killed, or worse, deported.

programme.title: Prince and Me 2: The Royal Wedding
programme.desc: The Prince and Me 2: The Royal Wedding continues the story of 2003's fantasy romance The Prince and Me. In the earlier film, Paige (Julia Stiles) - a midwestern college co-ed - falls in love with Edvard (Luke Mably), sans realizing that he is actually the Prince of Denmark. In this sequel, Paige (now played by neophyte Kam Heskin) and Eddie must confront a centuries-old Danish edict declaring that if a Danish prince marries a commoner, he must abdicate his throne. C

programme.title: Headwinds
programme.desc: Sarah tells Paul that she wants out of their marriage; the next day she disappears. A year later and Paul along with their children return to his childhood town to start anew after the loss of his wife and their mother.

programme.title: Treasure Island
programme.desc: Young Jim Hawkins and Peg-legged Long John Silver set sail for adventure in Robert Louis Stevenson's classic tale of dastardly pirates, swashbuckling heroes, buried treasure, and a young boy's courage during the adventure of a lifetime.

programme.title: I Could Never Be Your Woman
programme.desc: Rosie (Michelle Pfeiffer), is a 40-year-old divorced mother who works as a scriptwriter and producer for a TV show ''You Go Girl''. Rosie is insecure about her age, and uses cosmetics to maintain her appearance. She has a very close relationship with her thirteen-year-old daughter, Izzie (Saoirse Ronan), which becomes even closer when she learns that she has fallen for a boy in her class named Dylan (Rory Copus).

programme.title: Rat Race
programme.desc: Donald P. Sinclair has placed six separate gold coins in different slot machines in his casino. The lucky six who find these coins discover an opportunity of a lifetime. The chance to own $2 million. Locked up in a locker in New Mexico, these six contestants must now race each other, to be the first to the cash. There are no rules in place and everything that could possibly happen, does. Whilst, behind the scenes, Sinclair's associates are placing their bets.

programme.title: Railroad Tigers
programme.desc: In December 1941, Japan expands the occupation of its neighbouring countries to Southeast Asia. The railway from Tianjin to Nanjing in East China became a key military transportation route, heavily guarded by Japanese soldiers. Railroad worker Ma Yuan (Jackie Chan) leads a team of freedom fighters. Using his deep knowledge of the train network, he and his men sabotage it, ambushing Japanese soldiers and stealing supplies to feed the starving Chinese. Although the freedom fighters have no weapons of their own, they employ whatever tools are at hand, including a hammer and shovels, loose railway track planks and diverted trains. The local Chinese call the unlikely heroes the "Railroad Tigers". The freedom fighters find themselves on the wrong side of the tracks when the Japanese send reinforcements to Shandong. In an act of defiance, Ma Yuan launches his most dangerous mission yet, blowing up a heavily guarded railroad bridge. When the Japanese learn of the crippling plan, which will derail the war effort, the stakes are raised even higher. After many missed opportunities and missed shots, the bridge is blown up by the ragtag Chinese railroad tigers.

programme.title: Thick as Thieves
programme.desc: Two master thieves go at odds with one another as one sets the other up for a crime. The first (Alec Baldwin), a suave pro who does his job and then hides in his own privacy, listening to old jazz records and caring for his ailing dog, Wally. The other (Michael Jai White) is a local gangster with a taste for the finer life, who decides to eliminate the competition. This ignites a war between the two men and their aides. An angry mob boss (David Byrd) and a female police officer (Rebecca De Mornay) try to sort the mess before things get too out of hand.

programme.title: Second Acts
programme.desc: When a woman reports her daughter as missing, the Blue Heelers find she has moved in with her schoolteacher.

programme.title: High Voltage
programme.desc: A group of close-knit thieves are led by Johnny (Antonio Sabàto, Jr), Mollie (Amy Smart), Larry (Lochlyn Munro) and Sam (Mike Mains). Their latest target is a small bank in Little Saigon, Orange Country, California. Mollie has been working in the bank undercover for months with the bank's manager Jane (Shannon Lee) unaware of what she plans to do. On the day of the robbery, Johnny and the rest of the gang burst in, forcing everyone on the floor. Johnny orders Jane to open the bank vault. As she opens it, Johnny discovers a large cache of money which is laundered by a Vietnamese mobster named Victor Phan (George Kee Cheung). Instead of taking the money, they escape empty-handed. Victor orders his men to go after the gang and Jane is revealed to be Victor's mistress who is imprisoned by him. She wants to leave Victor but knows he would never let her go. Johnny and his gang manage to survive an attack on them by Victor's men and join forces with Jane, who offers them Victor's money if they kill him. On the night Victor is meeting with drug dealers at his nightclub, Johnny and his gang burst in, leading to a shootout. They successfully steal his money and escape with Jane, but Victor survives the attack, forcing the group to go on the run with Victor and his men after them.

programme.title: Hardball
programme.desc: Incompatible fugitive recovery agents, the flighty Jersey Bellini and his more serious-minded female partner, B.B., have, for the last time, ticked off mobster Wald by apprehending his rather inept henchmen just as they are about to commit a robbery or kill one of Wald's enemies. That's when Wald turns their fate over to the ruthless Crazy Carlos, with the intention of having Bellini and B.B. killed. But the hapless bounty hunters keep having good luck just when they need it most.

programme.title: Abduction
programme.desc: A man steps out of a park fountain in Ho Chi Minh City with no recollection of who he is or where he came from. As he wanders through the city, piecing together clues to his past, he is relentlessly pursued by mysterious figures.

programme.title: Back in the Day
programme.desc: A young boxer is taken under the wing of a mob boss after his Mother dies and his Father is run out of town for being an abusive alcoholic.

programme.title: Wings Of Eagles
programme.desc: The continuing true story of Eric Liddell's glorious life after winning Olympic gold in the 1924 Paris Olympics. Liddell has returned to China, where he was born to missionary parents, modestly avoiding celebrity in order to teach local schoolchildren. In 1937, the Japanese invade China at the outset of WWll. Liddell with his friend Xu Niu, a street smart resistance fighter, recognize the increasing danger so Liddell sends his wife, Florence and their two daughters to safety in Canada. Duty-bound, Liddell stays to minister to the civilian victims. Liddell and other foreign nationals are taken as prisoners and placed in one of the many Japanese internment camps where they are forced to endure for two years. Before the Japanese surrender, Liddell succumbs to a brain tumor. Yet his message of hope became immortal. Eric Liddell's legacy continues to this day as he remains admired as a champion for life.

programme.title: Score: A Hockey Musical
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Farley has led a sheltered life, raised on a diet of home schooling, organic living and trips to the art gallery. To his parents' dismay, Farley loves to play hockey with the local kids. To their even greater dismay, Farley is scouted and signed by the owner of a junior league team, where he becomes an instant star. But Farley discovers that stardom comes with a price - including the expectation to fight on the ice. Throw in a changing relationship with his best friend, and Farley finds himself losing his way.

programme.title: Jungle Boy
programme.desc: In a humble village on the edge of the jungle, a young boy strays from his mother to play with a monkey. Lost in the jungle, he is saved by the great elephant, who will raise him as a member of the great family of animals. When he grows up he helps to protect the jungle from a ruthless poacher.

programme.title: True Smile
programme.desc: Sergio, a 26-year-old autistic male is blind and has never seen a smile. He does, however, give everybody a sincere smile every day. A documentary based on the amazing story encapsulated by Sergio Aznarez Rosado's life.

programme.title: Talea
programme.desc: Summertime. Everybody is excited to go on vacation to Italy. Everybody but Jasmin. Jasmin is yearning something. She wants to be with Eva, her mother, from whom she had to live seperately for a long time. For weeks, Jasmin is trying to get close to Eva. She does not give up, even if she's rejected. After an argument, Jasmin runs away from her fosterhome and convinces Eva to leave the city together and go on a trip. The two get closer -- sometimes as friends, sometimes as mother and daughter. A first joint cigarette, a dance in the village disco, wanderings through the woods. But expectations and needs of the girl and her mother are diverging repeatedly, especially when a man attracts Eva's attention and disturbs the growing closeness between mother and daughter.

programme.title: Foolproof
programme.desc: Kevin, Samantha and Rob live for Foolproof; their own private club where through high-tech, meticulously thought out and executed plans, they pull off the most impossible of heists - all in theory that is. They've never actually done it for real. But all that changes when Leo, a cutthroat British gangster, rips off their foolproof plans for a diamond heist and uses it to successfully execute the robbery. Threatening to implicate them, Leo blackmails them to pull off a robbery worth $20 million in corporate bonds.

programme.title: Irish Jam
programme.desc: A South Central L.A. con artist with rap skills tries to keep bill collectors and his lover, with marriage in mind, at bay by entering a poetry contest staged by a small Irish town. Can his rhyming skills help the town and win him the prize money?

programme.title: North & South: The Battle of New Market
programme.desc: Based on a true story of the American Civil War, culminating at the Battle of New Market, May 1864. A group of teenage cadets sheltered from war at the Virginia Military Institute must confront the horrors of an adult world when they are called upon to defend the Shenandoah Valley. Leaving behind their youth, these cadets must decide what they are fighting for.

programme.title: Caesar
programme.desc: Epic look at Julius Caesar, Rome's last dictator, whose death also signaled the end of the Roman Republic. Chronicles his campaigns in Gaul and Egypt, his rivalry with General Pompey, and his eventual assassination at the hands of Brutus and Cassius.

programme.title: Caesar
programme.desc: Epic look at Julius Caesar, Rome's last dictator, whose death also signaled the end of the Roman Republic. Chronicles his campaigns in Gaul and Egypt, his rivalry with General Pompey, and his eventual assassination at the hands of Brutus and Cassius.

programme.title: Black Water
programme.desc: Scott Wheeler (Jean-Claude Van Damme), a deep cover operative awakens along with another prisoner, Marco (Dolph Lundgren), to find himself imprisoned in a CIA Blacksite on board a retrofitted nuclear submarine. Enlisting the help of a rookie agent and another prisoner, he must race against the clock to escape and discover who set him up.

programme.title: Out of Season
programme.desc: When a young drifter is forced to stay the winter in a small seaside town, he inadvertently becomes the catalyst for deceit, double crossings and murder amongst the locals.

programme.title: I Love Your Work
programme.desc: Gray Evans (Ribisi) and Mia Lang (Franka Potente) are a hot young acting couple whose marriage is already heading south after just a year. They make glamorous entrances at openings, get wasted behind VIP ropes at parties where they can hang with Elvis Costello (for real) and sit around reading their fan mail, all things guaranteed to generate quick viewer sympathy and identification. But the true measure of Gray's intense narcissism is his conviction that he's being celebrity stalked. Now, this could all be a fantasy, as could a film he may or may not have made on the subject. But his fixation is enormous enough that, not only does he imagine his own death, but he himself begins stalking, after a fashion, a videostore clerk (Joshua Jackson) whose wife (Marisa Coughlan) and life he sees as far happier than his own. Gray also fantasizes about a conventional life with a nice former girl friend (Ricci).

programme.title: Harb Karmouz
programme.desc: General Yousef al-Masri is a well-respected member of the police, living in Karamouz neighbourhood in Alexandria. When a girl raped by British soldiers comes to his station, he is determined to protect her. After he puts the soldier they arrested in custody, hell breaks loose and we witness a one man's fight against an entire army. The story takes place during the reign of King Farouk prior to the 1952 revolution in the English occupation of Egypt.

programme.title: Bounty Hunters
programme.desc: Jersey Bellini is a bounty hunter who forms an uneasy partnership with a rival to capture a fugitive. But the hunters soon discover that the crook is also the man the mob most wants dead!

programme.title: Sahāra
programme.desc: Kad pētnieks Dērks Pits atrod noslēpumainu monētu, kas saistīta ar vēsturisku leģendu, sākas viņa mūža aizraujošākie piedzīvojumi - bagātību meklējumos viņš ceļo cauri bīstamākajiem Āfrikas rietumu apgabaliem. Meklējot kuģi, ko vietējie dēvē par "Nāves kuģi" - sen pazudušu Pilsoņu kara kaujas kuģi, kurā glabājas slepena krava - Dērks un viņa asprātīgais ceļabiedrs Als Džordžino sastop daiļu sievieti un spožu zinātnieci Evu Rohas, kas uzskata, ka bruņukuģis ir saistīts ar daudzu cilvēku bojāeju šajā reģionā. Meklējot kuģi, ko daudzi uzskata par neesošu, Dērks, Als un Eva var paļauties tikai uz savu prātu un drošsirdību, lai pārspētu bīstamos militāristus un izdzīvotu mežonīgajos Sahāras apstākļos, atklājot senos noslēpumus.

programme.title: Sasalusī zeme
programme.desc: Maniaks Roberts Hansens savus noziegumus pastrādāja XX gs. 80. gados un tiek turēts aizdomās par 20 sieviešu noslepkavošanu. Viņš aizveda savus upurus Aļaskas savvaļā, vēroja tos un pēc tam medīja kā dzīvniekus. Maniaks dzīvoja kā gluži parasts cilvēks - bija kārtīgs ģimenes tēvs, ceptuves īpašnieks un krietns mednieks. Policijas centieni aizturēt slepkavu cieta sakāvi, un tā turpinājās veselus 13 gadus. Tikai policijas seržants Džeks Halkombs nenolaiž rokas un pamazām tuvojas mērķim - slepkavību noslēpuma atminējumam.

programme.title: Tev pienācis pasts
programme.desc: Ketlīnai pieder mazs, mīlīgs bērnu grāmatu veikaliņš, bet Džo ir milzīga uzņēmuma īpašnieks. Viņš cenšas pārpirkt vai iznīcināt visus mazāk ietekmīgos konkurentus, tai skaitā arī Ketlīnu. Tomēr sieviete nolēmusi nepadoties augstprātīgajam aprēķinātājam Džo. Ironiskā kārtā tieši viņi abi uzsākuši romantisku saraksti internētā un lēnām iemīlas viens otrā. Kas notiks, kad viņi satiksies dzīvē un atklās patieso identitāti? Galvenajās lomās Toms Henks un Mega Raiena.

programme.title: Marta īdas
programme.desc: "Marta īdas" ir aizraujošs stāsts par ambīcijām, uzticību, nodevību un atriebību. Filma veidota pēc populāras lugas motīviem, un tā stāsta par kādu mārketinga un publisko attiecību ģēniju, kurš ir gatavs uz visu, lai palīdzētu viņa pārstāvētajam prezidenta amata kandidātam uzvarēt vēlēšanās.

programme.title: Pirmsākums
programme.desc: Doms Kobbs ir augstas klases spiegošanas profesionālis, kurš spēj iegūt vērtīgu informāciju no cilvēkiem, iekļūstot viņu sapņu pasaulē. Būdams ļoti pieprasīts korporatīvajā spiegošanā, Kobbs kļuvis par starptautiska līmeņa bēgli, kuru vajā gan konkurenti, gan arī likumsargi. Piekritis veikt pēdējo uzdevumu, Kobbs ar savu palīgu grupu iekļūst kāda jauna biznesmeņa sapņos. Ejot cauri daudzajiem līmeņiem vizuāli iespaidīgajā sapņu pasaulē, Kobbs cenšas rast atbildes uz pagātnes notikumiem savā personīgajā dzīvē, kā arī ar jebkuriem līdzekļiem perfekti paveikt ideālu noziegumu. Galvenajās lomās: Leonardo di Kaprio, Džozefs Gordons Levits, Eliots Peidžs.

programme.title: Spartaks
programme.desc: Šķirts no savas dzimtās zemes un mīļotās sievietes, Spartacus ir notiesāts brutālai arēnas pasaulei, kur asinis un nāve ir primāra izklaide. Taču ne visas kaujas noris arēnā. Nodevība, korupcija un sensuālu baudu vilinājums patstāvīgi ieskaus varoni. Lai izdzīvotu, viņam ir jākļūst vairāk par vīrieti. Vairāk par parastu gladiatoru. Viņam ir jākļūst par leģendu.

programme.title: Cilvēks uz dzegas
programme.desc: Bijušais policists Niks Kesidijs, kurš netaisnīgi notiesāts uz 25 gadiem cietumā par neeksistējoša, neprātīgi dārga dimanta zādzību, izmanto pirmo izdevību, lai izbēgtu no ieslodzījuma. Viņa ceļš ved uz Manhetenas luksusa viesnīcu, kur Niks uzkāpj uz 21. stāva loga dzegas un draud nolēkt, piesaistot visas Ņujorkas uzmanību, medijus un policiju. Kamēr pieredzējusī sarunu vedēja Lidija Mersere cenšas atturēt Niku no liktenīgā soļa un saprast viņa motīvus, lejā pulcējas simtiem ziņkārīgo. Taču šķietamais pašnāvības mēģinājums ir tikai perfekti izplānots aizsegs. Kamēr visas pilsētas acis ir pievērstas vīram uz dzegas, pāri ielai Nika brālis un viņa draudzene uzsāk gadsimta pārdrošāko laupīšanu, lai atrastu it kā nozagto dimantu un pierādītu Nika nevainību. Pulkstenis tikšķ, un viena kļūda var maksāt dzīvību.

programme.title: Mortekajs
programme.desc: Čārlijs Mortekajs - deģenerāts aristokrāts, mākslas priekšmetu tirgotājs bez cieņas pret morāli, rūdīts epikūrietis, slepkava pret paša gribu, Londonas centra pārzinātāju visās jomās. Kopā ar savu rīkļurāvējam līdzīgo kalpotāju Džoku Čārlijs pārcieš visdažādākās nepatikšanas - slepenpoliciju, niknas ārvalstu valdības, zagtas gleznas un noslepkavotus klientus, lai tikai nopelnītu savu negodīgi gūstamo iztiku.

programme.title: Gredzenu pavēlnieks: Gredzena brālība
programme.desc: Džona Ronalda Rūela Tolkīna par kulta literatūru kļuvušo episko romānu triloģijas pirmās daļas ekranizējums. Trīspadsmit Oskara nominācijas, četras balvas! Tas ir stāsts par labā cīņu ar ļauno, par īstu draudzību un upurēšanos. Stāsts, kas tālu pārsniedz iztēles robežas... kas kļuvis par mītu, par leģendu!

programme.desc: Šķirts no savas dzimtās zemes un mīļotās sievietes, Spartacus ir notiesāts brutālai arēnas pasaulei, kur asinis un nāve ir primāra izklaide. Taču ne visas kaujas noris arēnā. programme.title: Viesnīca Artemīda
programme.desc: Filmas notikumi risinās tuvā nākotnē kādā nelegālā slimnīcā Losandželosā, kur slepus ārstējas pilsētas nežēlīgākie noziedznieki. Slimnīca, kas slēpjas aiz viesnīcas Artemīda izkārtnes, ir miera osta ļaundariem, taču viss mainās, kad iestādījuma vadītāja Džīna Tomasa atklāj, ka viens no pacientiem patiesībā te atrodas ar mērķi nogalināt otru pacientu.

programme.desc: Šķirts no savas dzimtās zemes un mīļotās sievietes, Spartacus ir notiesāts brutālai arēnas pasaulei, kur asinis un nāve ir primāra izklaide. Taču ne visas kaujas noris arēnā. Nodevība, korupcija un sensuālu baudu vilinājums patstāvīgi ieskaus varoni. Lai izdzīvotu, viņam ir jākļūst vairāk par vīrieti. Vairāk par parastu gladiatoru. Viņam ir jākļūst par leģendu.

programme.title: Kāzas Meksikā
programme.desc: Elija ar prieku plāno jaunākās māsas Mendijas kāzas, kas notiks Akapulko. Arī pašai viņai ir draugs Aleks, tomēr nav īsti skaidrs, vai viņš ir Elijas dzīves mīlestība, un viņi ar papīru sakārtošanu nesteidzas. Ieradusies Meksikā, Elija ir spiesta satikt savu bijušo draugu Gregu, kurš kāzās ir vedējtēvs. Kad līdz kāzām ir vien pāris dienas, un no jaunā pāra nav ne miņas, Elijai un Gregam jāmelo viesiem un jāizliekas, ka viss ir kārtībā. Kopīgi risinot problēmas, senās jūtas uzliesmo no jauna. Kad kāzās ierodas arī Aleks, Elijai jāpieņem sarežģīts lēmums.

programme.title: Alex Vs America
programme.desc: Brave and talented chefs attempt to take down Iron Chef Alex Guarnaschelli, the most feared and accomplished competition cook in America. Chef Alex goes up against three chefs in two rounds of cooking, and anyone -- even Alex -- can be sent home after a blind tasting by the judges. Each chef hails from a different state, but they all share the same culinary specialty and drive to beat Alex for ultimate bragging rights and $15,000.

programme.title: Alex Vs America
programme.desc: Chef Jet Tila curates a group of Thai chefs ready to blow Chef Alex Guarnaschelli out of the water with their skills in Thai cuisine. Previous Alex vs America winner Sugar Sungkamee and James Beard Nominee Arnold Myint join Chef Jet with a plan to take Alex down in the first round. In unfamiliar food territory, will Iron Chef Guarnaschelli be able to hold her own, or will she be forced to put down her knives in the first round? Host Eric Adjepong welcomes Thai experts Justin Pichetrungsi and Penny Chutima to judge in two rounds of spicy and intense cooking.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Step up to the counter and be amazed! Four delicatessen pros take over the Chopped Kitchen to prove that sandwiches are just the start of their culinary expertise. A platter with a classic combo and a fruit with a cult following are two of the ingredients in the appetizer basket. The chefs get a sweet soda and a stuffed spud to work with in round two, and a clever cold treat must be combined with a salty-sour condiment in the dessert round.

programme.title: Restaurant Impossible: Last Call
programme.desc: After 40 years, Toronto's oldest Hakka restaurant is on the verge of collapse. Jen Agg and Aarón Sánchez help two sisters who left successful careers to win back customers before their parents' livelihood and legacy disappears.

programme.title: Restaurant Impossible: Last Call
programme.desc: A passionate father is clinging to old-country recipes and control of his Peruvian bistro. Jen Agg and Aarón Sánchez give the tough love necessary to inspire change for a new reality and give his sons the confidence to prove they can take the reins.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond opens up in a fun Q and A about kids, with some of the questions coming from her pint-sized fans. Her answers include an 11-Carton Cake with a simple trick and vanilla buttercream frosting and a Ranch Pork Chop Sheet Pan Supper that's perfect for kids to help Mom with in the kitchen. Teriyaki Shrimp and Pineapple Parcels are happily devoured by kids who love seafood, and Ravioli a la Bobbi is named after one of Ree's young questioners.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. The Pioneer Woman is an open invitation into Ree Drummond's life: The award-winning blogger and best-selling cookbook author comes to Food Network and shares her special brand of home cooking, from throw-together suppers to elegant celebrations. The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond is taking some of her favorite recipes over the top! Her Mac and Cheese Stuffed Peppers are beer-battered and served with Cilantro Lime Cream and her Grilled French Toast is finished with Grilled Strawberries and a fabulous range of epic toppings. Then two fast food favorites star in a spectacular Fried Chicken Pizza with Slaw and a freaktastic Funnel Cake Sundae gets piled high with the good stuff.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond and her family are mourning the loss of Ladd's mother so she begins preparing lunch while the family works on tidying the ranch cemetery. There's a build-your-own BLT Bar -- Nan's all-time favorite where the 'T' is an Heirloom Tomato -- Watermelon Salad with feta, Homemade Mayo and Quick Pickles just like Nan's mom taught her how to make. On the side, there's a Skillet Corn Casserole made from Nan's classic recipe and Nan's Blackberry Cobbler is for dessert.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

programme.title: Halloween Baking Championship
programme.desc: Seven courageous bakers are tasked with creating terrifying desserts in this spooky baking competition. Hosted by ventriloquist Jeff Dunham and his sidekick Walter, the competition invites talented bakers to showcase their talents in Halloween-themed challenges. programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: Bobby's Triple Threat
programme.desc: Legendary chef Jet Tila is in Bobby Flay's club, and he's ready to be "not so friendly" to his friends, the Titans. Will this Emmy-nominated, James Beard-nominated and Guinness World Record-holding chef add Triple Threat Champion to his list of accolades? Global chef Lorena Garcia will be the judge of that.

programme.desc: Features one competitor per episode who enters Bobby's secret kitchen to compete against professional chefs in three head-to-head rounds. If the competitor can out-cook the titans and earn more points, they take home the cash prize.

programme.title: Chopped

At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: Get under the skin
programme.desc: The documentary project "Climbing Under the Skin" is a profound story about how Ukrainian tattoos have transformed from an aesthetic expression of personality into a symbol of invincibility, for which the occupiers punish with torture and death. The film reveals the fates of people who have gone through incredible trials because of their own beliefs: from soldiers whose patriotic drawings became the cause of brutal massacres, to craftswomen who risked their lives, branding Ukrainians with freedom under occupation. Combining real testimonies with animated reconstructions of events, the film draws a parallel between embroidery as a "genetic code" and tattoos as an integral part of inner freedom, which the enemy is trying to destroy, but which only eats deeper under the skin.

programme.title: Steel birds
programme.desc: Spring 2022. Mariupol is completely blocked by the enemy, and the defenders of Azovstal are holding a heroic defense. At this critical moment, Ukrainian pilots and scouts dare to take an unprecedented step - an extremely dangerous breakthrough of the airspace to the surrounded city. The documentary "Steel Birds" is dedicated to those who risked everything to deliver medicine, weapons, and reinforcements to the fighters, as well as to evacuate the wounded. The film reveals the personal stories of the participants in this unique operation, their memories of fateful decisions, and the extremely high price of this feat.

programme.title: Get under the skin
programme.desc: The documentary project "Climbing Under the Skin" is a profound story about how Ukrainian tattoos have transformed from an aesthetic expression of personality into a symbol of invincibility, for which the occupiers punish with torture and death. The film reveals the fates of people who have gone through incredible trials because of their own beliefs: from soldiers whose patriotic drawings became the cause of brutal massacres, to craftswomen who risked their lives, branding Ukrainians with freedom under occupation. Combining real testimonies with animated reconstructions of events, the film draws a parallel between embroidery as a "genetic code" and tattoos as an integral part of inner freedom, which the enemy is trying to destroy, but which only eats deeper under the skin.

programme.title: Īstas sāpes
programme.desc: Tik ļoti atšķirīgie un sen netikušies brālēni Deivids un Bendžijs atkal apvienojas ceļojumā uz Poliju, lai godinātu savu mirušo vecmāmiņu. Viņu piedzīvojums uzņem jaunus apgriezienus, kad neparastā pārīša seno dienu neatrisinātās pretrunas un sarežģītās attiecības atdzimst uz ģimenes vēstures fona.

programme.title: Stabilizators 3: Pēdējā nodaļa
programme.desc: Trilleris ar Denzelu Vašingtonu un Dakotu Feningu. Pēc darba gaitu beigām valdības specvienībā Roberts Makols pielicis lielas pūles, lai samierinātos ar šausminošajām pagātnē paveiktajām lietām. Mierinājumu viņš rod, aizstāvot apspiestos un vājākos. Negaidīti, Itālijas dienvidos sajuties kā mājās, viņš atklāj, ka viņa jaunos draugus kontrolē vietējās mafijas vadoņi. Kad notikumi uzņem bīstamu kursu, Makols zina, kas viņam jādara, - jākļūst par drauga aizstāvi, stājoties pretī mafijai.

programme.title: Operācija Black Bag
programme.desc: Izlūkdienesta aģente Katrīna Vudhausa tiek turēta aizdomās par valsts nodevību. Viņas vīrs, leģendārais slepenais aģents Džordžs Vudhauss, saskaras ar nepiespējamu pārbaudījumu – būt uzticīgam savai laulībai vai valstij.

programme.title: Cietais rieksts
programme.desc: 1988. gadā "Oskaram" nominētās cikla pirmās filmas turpinājums. Ņujorkas policists, tagad Losandželosas policijas darbinieks, Džons Makleins lidostā gaida savu sievu, kad pēkšņi ēkā iebrūk bruņoti tipi, kuri vēlas izglābt narkotirgoni, kas ir nogādāts ASV, lai tur stātos tiesas priekšā. Jau atkal Makleins iesaistās teroristu plānos, kurus izjaukt spēj tikai viņš…

programme.title: Nejaukais es
programme.desc: Mīlīgā mazpilsētiņā atrodas melna māja ar nedzīvu zālāju. Kaimiņi pat nenojauš, ka zem mājas atrodas milzu paslēptuve. Sīku pakalpiņu armijas apsargāts, Grū kaldina plānus lielākajai laupīšanai pasaules vēsturē. Viņš ir iecerējis nolaupīt Mēnesi. Jā, Mēnesi! Grū patīk viss ļaunais. Bruņojies ar samazināšanas lāzeru, sasaldēšanas staru un dažnedažādiem kaujas transporta līdzekļiem braukšanai pa zemi un pa gaisu, viņš iznīdē visu, kas gadās ceļā, līdz kādu dienu sastop trīs bārenītes ar apbrīnojamu gribasspēku…

programme.title: Viņš ir viņa
programme.desc: Ļoti brīva Šekspīra lugas "Divpadsmitā nakts" ekranizācija. Pārvācoties uz citu skolu, Viola maina arī savu izskatu un uzdodas par savu dvīņubrāli Sebastjanu, kurš pats pārcēlies uz Londonu. Taču meitene nemaz nenojauš, ka viņu gaida pārsteigums, – viņa iemīlēsies savā istabas biedrā un skolas karstākajā puisī Djūkā, kura sirds savukārt pieder skaistulei Olīvijai. Taču šī meitene ir pamanījusi Sebastjanu – emocionālo puisi, kādi viņai vienmēr patikuši. Un, kaut arī šķiet, ka nekas nevar būt vēl trakāk, ierodas īstais Sebastjans, kurš nemaz nenojauš, ka viņu aizvieto paša dvīņu māsa!

programme.title: Kā pieradināt pūķi
programme.desc: Skarbajā Berkas salā vikingi un pūķi ir bijuši ienaidnieki paaudžu paaudzēs. Šeit dzīvo Hikaps - jaunietis ar izgudrotāja spējām, varenā vikinga Lielā Stoika dēls. Hikaps pārkāpj gadsimtiem ilgas tradīcijas, sadraudzējoties ar Nezobu - mītiem apvīto Tumsas pūķi. Viņu neticamā draudzība atklās pūķu patieso dabu un pavērs ceļu jaunai ērai pūķu un vikingu pasaulē.

programme.title: Džonijs Pafs: Slepenā misija
programme.desc: Džonijs ar draugiem uzsāk slepenu misiju, lai glābtu ciemu no valzirga Oto ļaunajiem plāniem.

programme.title: Haralds un burvju krītiņš
programme.desc: Savā grāmatā piedzīvojumu kārais Haralds var atdzīvināt jebko, to vienkārši uzzīmējot. Pieaugot un attālinoties no grāmatas lappusēm un nonākot reālajā pasaulē, Haralds saprot, ka viņam ir daudz jāmācās par īsto dzīvi.

programme.title: Parastie eņģeļi
programme.desc: Kentuki štata Luisvilā friziere Šērona Stīvensa pulcē ļaudis, lai palīdzētu par atraitni palikušajam tēvam Edam Šmitam izglābt viņa smagi slimo piecgadīgo meitu Mišelu. Viņu kopienu skārusi spēcīga sniega vētra, ko izraisīja 1994. gadā notikušais aukstuma vilnis Ziemeļamerikā.

programme.title: Gran Turismo. No spēles līdz trasei
programme.desc: Patiess stāsts par strādnieku šķiras jaunieti Janu Mārdenboro, kura kaislība un izcilās prasmes populārajā autosacīkšu simulatorā "Gran Turismo" paver viņam reizi dzīvē doto iespēju nokļūt uz īstas autosacīkšu trases. Viss sākas ar ambiciozu mārketinga ideju - Nissan vadītājs Denijs Mūrs (Orlando Blūms) izveido projektu "GT Academy", lai labākos virtuālos braucējus pārvērstu par profesionāliem autosportistiem. Par jauniešu treneri kļūst cinisks un pieredzējis bijušais sacīkšu braucējs Džeks Solters (Deivids Harbors), kurš sākumā ir stingri pārliecināts, ka "džoistiku pavēlniekiem" nav vietas reālajā, bīstamajā autosporta pasaulē. Tomēr Jans pierāda pretējo. Izgājis cauri skarbai fiziskajai un mentālajai sagatavošanai, viņš izcīna vietu pie īstas sacīkšu formulas stūres.

programme.title: Tumšākā stunda
programme.desc: Kad Otrā pasaules kara laikā Ādolfa Hitlera varenā Vērmahta armija plosās Eiropā, Lielbritānijas premjerministrs Nevils Čemberleins ir spiests atkāpties no amata, savā vietā iesakot Vinstonu Čērčilu. Jau pašā premjera darbības sākumā Čērčilam jāizlemj, vai vest miera sarunas ar Vācijas diktatoru vai cīnīties ar šķietami neuzveicamo nacistu režīmu aci pret aci, lai ko tas arī prasītu. Neraugoties uz grūto un iespējami bīstamo lēmumu, Čērčilam nav citas izvēles, kā mirdzēt savas valsts tumšākajā stundā.

programme.title: Melnais telefons
programme.desc: Finns tagad ir septiņpadsmit gadus vecs. Kamēr viņš mēģina tikt galā ar savu dzīvi pēc nolaupīšanas, Finna māsa sapņos sāk saņemt zvanus no melna telefona un redz vīzijas par trim zēniem, kurus kāds izseko ziemas nometnē Alpīnleikā.

programme.title: Pasaules gala mednieki
programme.desc: Pēc tam kad milzīga saules uzliesmojuma dēļ tiek iznīcināta Zemes austrumu puslode, drosmīgs algots dārgumu mednieks dodas uz Eiropu, lai atrastu iekāroto "Monu Lizu", taču drīz saprot, ka pasaulei šobrīd vajag varoni vairāk nekā gleznu.

programme.title: Tintina piedzīvojumi: Vienradža noslēpums
programme.desc: Stīvena Spīlberga triloģijas pirmā filma par slaveno Tintinu, zēnu - reportieri.

programme.title: Vilkatis
programme.desc: Laulības izjukšanas laikā Bleiks pārliecina savu sievu Šarloti atpūsties no pilsētas un apmeklēt viņa attālo bērnības māju Oregonas laukos. Kad viņi ierodas lauku mājā pusnaktī, viņiem uzbrūk neredzēts dzīvnieks un viņi iebarikādējas mājā, kad radījums ložņā pa perimetru. Taču, kad nakts turpinās, Bleiks sāk uzvesties dīvaini, pārvēršoties par kaut ko neatpazīstamu.

programme.title: LaLiga. Real Madrid - Sevilla
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.
